title: Transports
excerpt: Transports in the Model Context Protocol (MCP) provide the foundation for communication between clients and servers. A transport handles the underlying mechanics of how messages are sent and received. Message Format MCP uses JSON RPC 2.0 as its wire format. The transport layer is responsible for converting MCP protocol messages into JSON RPC format for transmission and converting received JSON RPC messages back into MCP protocol messages.
